selection.scopeGate: A method is selectable only when one of its scopes is in the task scope set.
selection.evidenceOverride: Repository evidence and Arq invariants outrank any creative or persuasive method.

scopes.prod: Product behaviour, editor UX and workflows.

families.title: Write
families.note: Shape prose without changing governed meaning.

families.title: Explain
families.note: Match explanation depth to the reader.

families.title: Create
families.note: Widen the option set before converging.

families.title: Decide
families.note: Converge with criteria, evidence and reversibility.

families.title: Ship
families.note: Produce the deliverable and its shape.

methods.label: /firstprinciples
methods.effect: Rebuild the problem from fundamentals instead of inherited shape.

methods.label: /assumptions
methods.effect: List what the proposal takes for granted and mark each as verified or unverified.

methods.label: HIDDENASSUMPTIONS
methods.effect: Surface beliefs the author did not state about files, browsers, users, sync, precision or scale.

methods.label: META
methods.effect: Check whether the stated question is the right question before answering it.

methods.label: X10THINK
methods.effect: Ask what a ten times larger, faster or more constrained version demands.

methods.label: DELTR
methods.effect: Isolate the smallest real delta between current and target behaviour.

methods.label: FRACTAL
methods.effect: Check whether the same defect repeats at package, module and function scale.

methods.label: LENSSTACK
methods.effect: Read the problem through several fixed lenses in sequence rather than one.

methods.label: SYSTEMMAP
methods.effect: Draw the actors, state owners, boundaries and flows before changing any of them.

methods.label: PARADOX
methods.effect: Name the two requirements that cannot both hold and resolve the tension explicitly.

methods.label: SIGNALVSNOISE
methods.effect: Separate what materially changes the outcome from what only adds volume.

methods.label: HYPOTHESISGEN
methods.effect: Generate competing causal hypotheses before selecting one to test.

methods.label: REVERSEENGINEER
methods.effect: Derive the intended contract from the code, tests and artifacts that exist.

methods.label: BLACKSWAN
methods.effect: Consider the rare, high-consequence failure that the normal path ignores.

methods.label: /why
methods.effect: Chain causal why questions until the real driver is reached.

methods.label: /deep
methods.effect: Increase reasoning depth for consequential work.

methods.label: /human
methods.effect: Remove machine cadence and unearned emphasis from prose.

methods.label: /rewrite
methods.effect: Rewrite the text while preserving verified meaning.

methods.label: /improve
methods.effect: Improve clarity and precision without inflating claims.

methods.label: /shorten
methods.effect: Reduce length without losing a governed fact.

methods.label: /expand
methods.effect: Add the missing detail a reader needs to act.

methods.label: /simplify
methods.effect: Reduce reading difficulty while keeping the technical statement true.

methods.label: /formal
methods.effect: Shift register upward for specifications, ADRs and legal-adjacent text.

methods.label: /casual
methods.effect: Shift register downward where the surface allows it.

methods.label: /tonechange
methods.effect: Change register deliberately for a named surface.

methods.label: /clarify
methods.effect: Remove ambiguity a reader could resolve two ways.

methods.label: /reframe
methods.effect: Restate the same verified fact from the reader’s position.

methods.label: /compress
methods.effect: Compress to the smallest form that still carries the decision.

methods.label: ELI5
methods.effect: Explain at an absolute beginner level without false simplification.

methods.label: EL10
methods.effect: Explain at an early-learner level.

methods.label: EL15
methods.effect: Explain at a competent-non-specialist level.

methods.label: ELICollege
methods.effect: Explain at an undergraduate technical level.

methods.label: ELIPhD
methods.effect: Explain at a specialist level with precise terminology.

methods.label: /analogies
methods.effect: Use an analogy that survives the edge cases it will be tested on.

methods.label: FEYNMAN
methods.effect: Explain until no undefined term remains, then name what is still unclear.

methods.label: /teachme
methods.effect: Teach the topic in a structured progression.

methods.label: /examples
methods.effect: Ground the explanation in concrete worked examples.

methods.label: /usecases
methods.effect: State the real situations the capability serves.

methods.label: MISCONCEPTIONS
methods.effect: Name what readers usually get wrong and correct it directly.

methods.label: IDEAS10
methods.effect: Produce ten distinct options before converging.

methods.label: ALT3
methods.effect: Produce three genuinely different approaches, not three variants of one.

methods.label: IDEAGEN
methods.effect: Generate directions from an explicit constraint set.

methods.label: /brainstorm100
methods.effect: Generate a wide unfiltered set before any filtering.

methods.label: SCAMPER
methods.effect: Substitute, combine, adapt, modify, repurpose, eliminate, reverse.

methods.label: REMIX
methods.effect: Recombine existing proven parts into a new arrangement.

methods.label: HOOKS10
methods.effect: Produce ten opening lines for a marketing surface.

methods.label: HOOK10
methods.effect: Produce ten opening lines for a marketing surface.

methods.label: /viralhooks
methods.effect: Produce attention-first openings for growth surfaces.

methods.label: /improvehooks
methods.effect: Strengthen an existing opening without overclaiming.

methods.label: SCRIPT
methods.effect: Produce a spoken or demo script.

methods.label: THREAD
methods.effect: Produce a sequential social format.

methods.label: /storymode
methods.effect: Carry the point through narrative rather than assertion.

methods.label: /simulate
methods.effect: Walk a concrete user or system session step by step.

methods.label: /futurehistory
methods.effect: Write the retrospective of the decision from a future vantage point.

methods.label: /expandideas
methods.effect: Develop the surviving option into a workable shape.

methods.label: DECIDE
methods.effect: Commit to one option with stated criteria, evidence and reversibility.

methods.label: PROSCONS
methods.effect: List advantages and costs symmetrically.

methods.label: SWOT
methods.effect: Assess strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats.

methods.label: COMPARE
methods.effect: Compare candidates against fixed criteria rather than impressions.

methods.label: PARETO
methods.effect: Identify the small share of work carrying most of the outcome.

methods.label: RISKMAP
methods.effect: Map risks by likelihood, consequence and detectability.

methods.label: SECONDORDER
methods.effect: Trace the consequences of the consequences.

methods.label: /predict
methods.effect: State what the change will cause, in falsifiable terms.

methods.label: /counter
methods.effect: State the strongest counter-argument to the current direction.

methods.label: /steelman
methods.effect: Build the strongest honest version of the rejected option.

methods.label: /devilsadvocate
methods.effect: Argue the opposing position in good faith.

methods.label: /debate
methods.effect: Run both positions to a resolution rather than a summary.

methods.label: KILLCRITIC
methods.effect: Critique without softening, naming what would actually fail.

methods.label: REDTEAM
methods.effect: Attack the design as an adversary with real capability.

methods.label: /critique
methods.effect: Review against explicit criteria and report real defects.

methods.label: /reverse
methods.effect: Work backwards from the failure state to the change that prevents it.

methods.label: OODA
methods.effect: Run short observe, orient, decide, act cycles under uncertainty.

methods.label: QUIZME
methods.effect: Test recall and understanding with graded questions.

methods.label: FLASHCARDS
methods.effect: Produce spaced-repetition pairs.

methods.label: TESTME
methods.effect: Assess mastery against stated objectives.

methods.label: SOCRATIC
methods.effect: Lead to the answer through questions rather than assertion.

methods.label: /socratic
methods.effect: Lead to the answer through questions rather than assertion.

methods.label: TIMELINE
methods.effect: Order events or decisions chronologically with causes.

methods.label: /coach
methods.effect: Coach the operator toward doing the work themselves.

methods.label: /insights
methods.effect: Extract the transferable lessons from the work just done.

methods.label: TLDR
methods.effect: Give the shortest correct summary first.

methods.label: BULLETS
methods.effect: Return the result as bullet points.

methods.label: TABLE
methods.effect: Return the result as a table with fixed columns.

methods.label: CHECKLIST
methods.effect: Return the result as a verifiable checklist.

methods.label: STEPS
methods.effect: Return the result as ordered steps.

methods.label: /stepbystep
methods.effect: Return the result as ordered steps.

methods.label: /outline
methods.effect: Return a structural outline before the prose.

methods.label: /summary
methods.effect: Return a proportionate summary of the whole.

methods.label: /keypoints
methods.effect: Return only the load-bearing points.

methods.label: /breakdown
methods.effect: Decompose the work into named parts with owners.

methods.label: /convert
methods.effect: Convert between formats without losing governed meaning.

methods.label: /translate
methods.effect: Translate while preserving governed terminology.

methods.label: DEBUG
methods.effect: Locate the defect by evidence and prove the repair.

methods.label: EXPLAINCODE
methods.effect: Explain what existing code actually does, including its edge behaviour.

methods.label: OPTIMIZE
methods.effect: Improve a measured cost without changing contract behaviour.

methods.label: /systemrewrite
methods.effect: Rebuild a subsystem deliberately with migration and rollback.

methods.label: /autoprompt
methods.effect: Compose the method stack automatically from the request.

methods.label: /godmode
methods.effect: Apply full appropriate rigour within scope. Never unlimited scope or unsupported claims.
